news.analysis: McGowan had been a bright spot for the struggling Colts in recent weeks, as the rookie back has looked like a capable ball carrier behind veteran Jonathan Taylor. Unfortunately, he sustained a hamstring injury after just a few touches Thursday night and did not return to the contest. McGowan has averaged an impressive 5.0 yards on his 58 total carries with two touchdowns so far this season. He's got plenty of fantasy value sharing the backfield with Taylor as long as the injury doesn't force him to miss time.
news.contents: Seth McGowan gained seven yards on three carries and just one yard on one catch before exiting Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with a hamstring injury.
news.title: Seth McGowan gets four touches, leaves with injury Thursday night

news.contents: The Indianapolis Colts ruled out running back Seth McGowan (hamstring) for the rest of the Thursday night game against the division-rival Houston Texans after he injured his hamstring towards the end of the first half on a kickoff, according to Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Sports. It ends a disappointing night for the 25-year-old rookie after his career-best performance in the Week 10 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday, when he had 12 carries for 77 yards and his second touchdown in as many weeks....
